Class Frigate

java.lang.Object
iscteiul.ista.battleship.Ship
iscteiul.ista.battleship.Frigate
All Implemented Interfaces:
IShip
public class Frigate extends Ship
Represents a frigate (Fragata) occupying four consecutive positions. North and south bearings place it vertically; east and west place it horizontally.

  • Constructor Details

    • Frigate

      public Frigate(Compass bearing, IPosition pos) throws java.lang.IllegalArgumentException
      Creates a frigate extending from the supplied position towards increasing row indices for a vertical bearing or increasing column indices for a horizontal bearing. Board boundaries are checked when adding it to a fleet.
      Parameters:
      bearing - the non-null cardinal direction of the frigate
      pos - the non-null topmost or leftmost position of the frigate
      Throws:
      java.lang.IllegalArgumentException - if bearing is Compass.UNKNOWN
